subject: Minimum commit pathways & trial-bridge pricing for Hosted API
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex@skylark.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question on minimum monthly spend / trial bridge

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Alex here from Skylark AI. The product looked promising. Before I loop in procurement I need a quick sanity check on hosted pricing: what are the minimum monthly commit options for customers who aren’t ready for Dedicated yet? Our CFO wants to understand (a) baseline monthly spend to get enterprise terms, (b) whether you offer a short-term trial bridge with credits that count toward a first commit, and (c) whether there’s a min commit to unlock discounted token rates or SLAs.

We’re targeting a Q3 pilot (100-200k generated tokens/month initially). Also attaching our expected pilot scope.

Cheers,
Alex
Head of Product, Skylark AI
[attachment: Skylark_trial_scope.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex@skylark.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-22T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on minimum monthly spend / trial bridge

Hi Alex — great to hear and glad yesterday was useful. Short answers up front, details below:

- Baseline (starter) commit: $5,000/month (hosted API) — includes priority support and 30-day rolling notice.
- Trial bridge: we can provide $10k in trial credits applied to the first two months; credits can be rolled into the first commit if you convert to a paid commit within 60 days.
- Discounted token rates & SLAs: unlocked at $25k/month commit (tiered discounts beyond that).

Longer version: for teams not ready for Dedicated, we typically recommend the starter commit to get SLA parity with paid customers and access to higher rate limits. If you want flexibility we can do a 60-day trial-bridge arrangement: Redwood issues $10k of credits (example: $6k month 1, $4k month 2) while we run the pilot. If you sign a 6+ month commit afterward, we apply those credits pro-rata to the committed term — effectively reducing your first invoice.

I’ve attached our current rate card (PDF) and a sample MSA template. Marcus — tagging you for pricing flexibility and any short-term promotional levers we can offer for Skylark.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send a short MA + quote reflecting the $5k starter and trial-bridge.
2) If they want steeper discounts, we can propose a $25k tier with a 10–15% rebate schedule tied to a 6–12 month commit.
3) Schedule procurement-friendly call with your Ops/CFO next week.

Best,
Steph
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_RateCard_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Alex Gomez <alex@skylark.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-22T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on minimum monthly spend / trial bridge

Alex — welcome, and thanks for the clear scope. A couple of clarifications from our side on the commercial plumbing: 

- The $5k starter commit is intentionally simple: monthly invoice, standard hosted token rates, and 14-day SLA for critical incidents. It’s designed for pilots and smaller pilots who want predictable spend.
- Trial credits are not amortized beyond 60 days unless you execute the commit; we can make a one-time exception to roll credits into a signed 6-month commit (this requires approval).
- Procurement/PO: we accept PO + Net30 for deals at or above the $5k/month starter; for promotional exceptions we can do Net45 with a signed SOW.

Lauren — can you confirm whether we need additional clauses for the trial-bridge (credits applied to first invoice) or if the standard MA template covers this?

Marcus
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Alex Gomez <alex@skylark.ai>
Date: 2026-05-22T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on minimum monthly spend / trial bridge

Hi all — I reviewed the ask and the standard MA covers credits applied to the first invoice provided the customer signs within the 60-day conversion window. If Skylark needs the credits guaranteed to be counted toward future discounts we should add a short addendum that references the trial credit schedule and conversion mechanics (simple clause, 2–3 lines).

Also noted: Skylark’s pilot size (100–200k tokens/month) sits clearly in our starter band. If they scale faster and hit 500k+/month we’ll automatically shift them to the $25k tier pricing conversation.

I attached the MA template with the credit clause highlighted — happy to prep the addendum and include a clause that the credits are non-refundable but applied to the first committed term.

Lauren Bishop
Commercial Counsel, Redwood Inference
[attachment: MA_template.docx (DOCX)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex@skylark.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Sales Ops <ops@skylark.ai>
Date: 2026-05-22T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on minimum monthly spend / trial bridge

Thanks Alex — glad that aligns. I’ll send a short quote and MA addendum today that reflects:
- Starter commit: $5,000/month (month-to-month)
- Trial-bridge: $10,000 in credits applied over first 60 days; credits count toward first committed term if signed within 60 days
- Upgrade path: $25k/month unlocks volume discounts and SLA bump

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll attach the quote + DocuSign link by EOD.
2) Schedule procurement call with your Ops/CFO — suggested times: Tue/Thu next week morning PT.
3) We’ll start the pilot once the trial credits are active; activation takes ~48 hours after signature.

Would you prefer the credits split as 6k/4k over two months or a single $10k credit upfront? We can do either.

Best,
Steph
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
